status: Post-hoc descriptive search after all individual results and Claudes proposed blend are known. NOT a new registered holdout or confirmatory score.

catalog.equalWeightSubsets: All511 nonempty subsets of9 point forecasts, including singletons and the original/persistence comparators.
catalog.unequalPairs: For every36 unordered pair, also25/75 and75/25 weights:72 further recipes;50/50 is already in subsets.
catalog.matrix: 9x9; diagonal individual forecast; offdiagonal equal50/50 average.
catalog.arithmetic: Average ladder and GDP level predictions with identical recipe weights on both outputs; never average MAEs. No fitted parameters, country/horizon routing, negative weights or policy-equation integration.
catalog.scopeLimit: Every combination in this finite declared catalog, not all real-valued weights or all possible model designs.
catalog.longObjective: Report separately; do not blend life-expectancy years into ladder points or mix1980 and2018 origins.

comparison.cohort: Exact original100 country origins;700 country-years. Match by(id,year), never row order. Preserve28 original exclusions.
comparison.metrics: MAE, RMSE, bias, skill1-modelMAE/persistenceMAE; identical target-specific masks. GDP errors100*(predicted-actual)/originGDP.
comparison.primaryDisplay: 2025 endpoint, as registered by both leading entries. Pooled2019–2025 always alongside.
comparison.breakdowns: Each horizon; fixed2018income quartiles; country improvements/losses. No hidden future-based country deletion.
comparison.selection: Report best individual, best equal-weight subset and best full-catalog recipe separately for endpoint and pooled. No single arbitrary combined ladder/GDP score. Show Pareto tradeoffs and rich-country failure.
comparison.combinationBenefit: Compare blend both with persistence and its strongest included constituent; preserve cases worse than a constituent.
comparison.errorCorrelation: Pearson correlation of signed errors on common observed masks; descriptive only, including shared common shocks.
comparison.bootstrap: 2000 paired country-block resamples, Python random.Random seed20260916; retain all observed years within each country. Percentile2.5/97.5 MAE-difference ranges for c_decay vs g_offset, equalc_decay/g_offset blend vs g_offset, g_health vs g_offset, and c_retained vs c_decay. Conditional on these observed years; no correction for selection, no future-shock or causal uncertainty, no significance claim.

audit: Independently recompute saved individual metrics from frozen predictions; compare to stored outputs; independently reconstruct Claudes rho and both predictionvariants from training/origin. No rerun of original scoring scripts or mutation of old scores. Count source/forecast bounds, identify registration/enforcement limits.
knownLimitations: All source outcomes already seen; re-ranking and blend selection consume no fresh evidence.
